title: Frank & Atticus – Caramel Glazed Doughnut 100ml
description:
Frank & Atticus – Caramel Glazed Doughnut 100ml
Frank & Atticus’ Caramel Glazed Donut is a one-of-a-kind dessert or brunch vape experience. Doughnuts that have been freshly cooked and dipped in a delicious caramel glaze.
Warm fluffy cake balanced with golden bakery undertones greets you as you inhale.
On the exhale, you’ll get a luscious caramel glaze with a rounded, sweet finish that will leave your taste buds yearning for more.
Frank & Atticus vape juices come in 60ml/100ml bottles with 0MG nicotine. If you love dessert e-liquids, the Frank & Atticus juice range is a must-try!
